prose: WHAT EXISTS lists an absent file but not the existing directory it would be written into, so the reader concludes the directory is absent too. Measured 2026-10-29 on 284798998ab0 rehearsal pass 3 (CairnCommons/rehearsals/284798998ab0-20261029T203646.json): the plan cites cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_the_ticket_is_three_files.py (a file the build creates) and cairn/tools/base/proofs/suite_parity.py (likewise); WHAT EXISTS printed both as absent and named no cairn/tools/base/proofs/ entry, while cairn/tools/base/probes/ (cited elsewhere) rode as present; read 1 stopped D9, D10 and D11 on 'plan specifies cairn/tools/base/proofs/ but WHAT EXISTS lists only cairn/tools/base/probes/'. `ls -d cairn/tools/base/proofs` finds it. The fix sits in cairn/machines/rehearsal/rehearsal.py what_exists: for an absent relative path whose parent directory exists at a root, also list that parent as a present path.
